Improved `0.html`:

- Gave the circle a fill color (was invisible/black-on-black-ish default) and shrank radius slightly so the stroke area isn't clipped at the SVG edge.
- Made the SVG responsively sized (`min(80vw, 400px)`) instead of a fixed 400px, so it works on small screens.
- Added a light background, `box-sizing: border-box`, a real page title, and `role="img"`/`aria-label` for accessibility.
